# How Some Web Designers Charge 100x More

## Featuring Ran Segall

**Creator:** Ran Segall  
**Channel:** [Flux Academy](https://www.youtube.com/@FluxAcademy)  
**Subscribe:** https://www.youtube.com/@FluxAcademy  
**Original video:** [How Some Web Designers Charge 100x More](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123)

---

## Key Takeaway

> Stop selling hours — sell the business outcome your design produces.

## Key Points

1. **Hourly billing caps your ceiling** — Ran says "the price is a story you tell about value" — hourly billing puts a hard ceiling on what you can ever earn.
2. **Raised his floor to $12,000** — He raised his minimum project fee from $3,000 to $12,000 in eighteen months by refusing smaller scopes.
3. **The call is the sale** — By the time a proposal goes out, the client has already decided — the discovery call is doing the actual selling.

## Tactics

### The Value Conversation _(pricing)_

A discovery call structured to surface the dollar value of the project: ask what the site is supposed to do, get them to name the revenue number, then anchor the fee to 10% of that number, with a $12,000 floor.

## Quotes

> "The price is a story you tell about value."
>
> — Ran Segall

> "You don't get paid for the hours. You get paid for the years you spent learning to do it in those hours."
>
> — Ran Segall (14:22)

---

All credit to Ran Segall. Watch the full video and subscribe to Flux Academy — that's where the real work lives.

**▶ [How Some Web Designers Charge 100x More](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123)**
